title: Research: uniform selected-k8 frame optimum and optimal-profile rigidity
body:
PR #1671 certifies the selected k8 word's frame optimum at two exponents. This contribution audits its unchanged symbolic duals and proves that the same paid histogram minimizes the frame LP for **every `0 <= a <= 1/32`**. For **`0 < a <= 1/32`, every optimal assignment has exactly that histogram**, although its frames can differ. The interval includes the `1/99` planning target.

This is one scoped proof extension and arithmetic audit, **no new kappa or physical supplier**. Only `research/selected-k8-uniform-frame-audit/` is added. The source word, event/domain model, endpoints, scalar chronology, centre cut and cleanup/cone contract remain fixed. The original physical decoder construction gate is not claimed satisfied.

### Exact evidence

- Reconstructs all **23,004 LP columns, 17,507 rows and 135 component objectives**; a second column assembly works directly from the shared event graph and agrees on every cost and residual.
- The 239 distinct rational residual vectors comprise one zero vector (16,564 columns), one exact square (10 columns), and 237 vectors (6,430 columns) proved positive uniformly by rational degree-eight Bernstein coefficients. No floating-point or solver output certifies the interval.
- Strict positivity outside the identically-zero columns plus symbolic objective equality proves optimal-profile rigidity. Rank-one counts follow from the invariant local mass 5,586. A distinct feasible model assignment at gate G616 retains the full histogram.
- Exact boundary controls show this particular dual fails for `min(r,2)` and at `a=1/20`. Neither control supplies a cheaper feasible assignment or contradicts #1671. The interval is not claimed maximal.

The written argument is in `PROOF.md`; `RESULT.json` retains every distinct residual/multiplicity and sign certificate. Canonical receipt: `859fcb8c40601ce3a1d453b5703f20268c5bfab2228aac8484e1cbba47aea703`.

### Reproduce and validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-k8-uniform-frame-audit
```

Passed on macOS 26.5.2 arm64 / CPython 3.12.12, standard library only:

- Registered replay, metadata/source pins and **all eight test groups**, including integer-root arithmetic at three sample exponents, exact Bernstein basis identities, dual/objective/column/domain mutations, damaged sources/receipts, and optimized read-only relocation.
- Optimized mathematical replay from a clean Git export of contribution commit **`cd696b3df479cd221ca812f2eb0804027a44da2f`** reproduces the same receipt.
- `make selected-record-check` passes separately.
- The pinned PR1671 package's separate checker was also replayed unchanged: `PASS_K8_FRAME_INDEPENDENT components=135 columns=23004 root_calibrations=72 graph_and_duality_match=True`.

Both new column assemblies **share the inherited event/domain model**; this is not an independent implementation or proof of the physical interface. Full selected cold replay, native/hosting admission, all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, precision/tape, analytic/bit H1-H5 obligations, Lean and human review are unclaimed. Local checks do not establish hosted-CI success or maintainer acceptance.
